description: 20-instance ContextBench run comparing vanilla Codex against Codex Spark with Memtrace MCP installed, started, structurally indexed without embeddings, and available before each scored benchmark task.

variants.name: baseline
variants.description: Run vanilla Codex Spark without Memtrace resources.
variants.notes: Explicit control variant. Uses the same Codex model, reasoning effort, timeout, runtime backend, and environment file as the treatment, without Memtrace installation or setup.

variants.name: with-memtrace-mcp
variants.description: Install pinned Memtrace, configure Codex MCP/skills in the isolated runtime, start the local Memtrace daemon, and index the checked-out repository before the scored task.
variants.notes: Uses Memtrace 0.6.46 from npm. The license is supplied through the ignored runtime_env_file (.env), not tracked config. Runtime setup writes Codex MCP/skills into the isolated runtime home, removes Codex hook registration, starts Memtrace headlessly, indexes the workspace, and validates status before the scored prompt. This limit-20 Spark run disables Memtrace embeddings and replay to avoid setup timeouts observed on larger repositories while preserving structural indexing and MCP tool availability.

setup.prompt_preamble: Memtrace MCP is connected and this repository is indexed. Use native Memtrace MCP tools for initial code discovery, symbol context, and impact analysis before broad text search or source edits, then read and edit files normally. Continue to a concrete patch; do not stop at analysis-only output.

runtime_setup_commands_add: test -n "${MEMTRACE_LICENSE_KEY:-}" || { echo "MEMTRACE_LICENSE_KEY is required for Memtrace benchmark treatment" >&2; exit 2; }
test -n "${MEMTRACE_AUTH_DEVICE_ID:-}" || { echo "MEMTRACE_AUTH_DEVICE_ID is required for Memtrace benchmark treatment" >&2; exit 2; }

test "${MEMTRACE_TELEMETRY:-}" = "off" && test "${MEMTRACE_RAIL_SHADOW:-}" = "off" && test "${MEMTRACE_NO_REMOTE_RECEIPT:-}" = "1" && test "${OTEL_SDK_DISABLED:-}" = "true" || { echo "Memtrace privacy opt-out env is not configured" >&2; exit 2; }

for i in $(seq 1 30); do node -e 'fetch(process.env.MEMTRACE_AUTH_URL + "/health").then(r => process.exit(r.ok ? 0 : 1)).catch(() => process.exit(1))' && exit 0; sleep 1; done; cat "$CONTEXTBENCH_TASK_DIR/http-json-rewrite-proxy.log" >&2; exit 1

node "$(npm root -g)/memtrace/installer/dist/index.js" install --only codex --global --yes && rm -f "$HOME/.codex/hooks.json" && test -f "$HOME/.codex/config.toml" && grep -q '\[mcp_servers.memtrace\]' "$HOME/.codex/config.toml" && printf '
required = true
startup_timeout_sec = 60
tool_timeout_sec = 120
default_tools_approval_mode = "auto"
env_vars = ["MEMTRACE_LICENSE_KEY", "MEMTRACE_AUTH_DEVICE_ID", "MEMTRACE_AUTH_URL", "MEMTRACE_TELEMETRY", "MEMTRACE_RAIL_SHADOW", "MEMTRACE_NO_REMOTE_RECEIPT", "OTEL_SDK_DISABLED", "MEMTRACE_HEADLESS", "MEMTRACE_DATA_DIR", "MEMTRACE_MEMDB_DATA_DIR", "MEMTRACE_SKIP_EMBED", "MEMTRACE_NO_REPLAY", "CONTEXTBENCH_RUNTIME_ROOT", "CONTEXTBENCH_RUNTIME_BIN", "NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX", "PATH"]
' >> "$HOME/.codex/config.toml"

! grep -Eiq 'Indexed[[:space:]].*0.*nodes[[:space:]]+-[[:space:]]+0.*edges|no git repositories found' "$CONTEXTBENCH_TASK_DIR/memtrace-index.log" || { cat "$CONTEXTBENCH_TASK_DIR/memtrace-index.log" >&2; exit 1; }

for i in $(seq 1 90); do memtrace status > "$CONTEXTBENCH_TASK_DIR/memtrace-status.log" 2>&1 && ! grep -Eiq 'Cannot reach MemDB|License check failed|license.*failed|did not become ready|previous memtrace daemon|No data indexed yet|0 nodes - 0 edges' "$CONTEXTBENCH_TASK_DIR/memtrace-status.log" && exit 0; sleep 2; done; cat "$CONTEXTBENCH_TASK_DIR/memtrace-status.log" >&2; exit 1
runtime_validation_commands_add: test -f "$HOME/.codex/config.toml" && grep -q '\[mcp_servers.memtrace\]' "$HOME/.codex/config.toml" && grep -q 'required = true' "$HOME/.codex/config.toml" && grep -q 'env_vars = .*MEMTRACE_AUTH_URL' "$HOME/.codex/config.toml" && grep -q 'env_vars = .*CONTEXTBENCH_RUNTIME_ROOT' "$HOME/.codex/config.toml" && test ! -e "$HOME/.codex/hooks.json"

codex mcp get memtrace > "$CONTEXTBENCH_TASK_DIR/codex-memtrace-mcp.txt" 2>&1 && grep -q 'enabled: true' "$CONTEXTBENCH_TASK_DIR/codex-memtrace-mcp.txt" && grep -Eq 'command:.*memtrace|args:.*mcp' "$CONTEXTBENCH_TASK_DIR/codex-memtrace-mcp.txt"

memtrace status > "$CONTEXTBENCH_TASK_DIR/memtrace-status-final.log" 2>&1 && ! grep -Eiq 'Cannot reach MemDB|License check failed|license.*failed|did not become ready|No data indexed yet|0 nodes - 0 edges' "$CONTEXTBENCH_TASK_DIR/memtrace-status-final.log"

ok=0; tools_out="$CONTEXTBENCH_RUNTIME_ROOT/mcp-tools.json"; tools_err="$CONTEXTBENCH_RUNTIME_ROOT/mcp-tools.stderr.log"; for i in $(seq 1 20); do "$CONTEXTBENCH_RUNTIME_ROOT/bin/mcp-tool" --list > "$tools_out" 2> "$tools_err" && grep -q '"list_indexed_repositories"' "$tools_out" && { ok=1; break; }; sleep 3; done; test "$ok" = 1 || { cat "$tools_err" >&2; exit 1; }

ok=0; repos_out="$CONTEXTBENCH_RUNTIME_ROOT/mcp-repos.json"; repos_err="$CONTEXTBENCH_RUNTIME_ROOT/mcp-repos.stderr.log"; for i in $(seq 1 20); do "$CONTEXTBENCH_RUNTIME_ROOT/bin/mcp-tool" list_indexed_repositories '{}' > "$repos_out" 2> "$repos_err" && grep -Eq 'repo_id|repos|repositories' "$repos_out" && { ok=1; break; }; sleep 3; done; test "$ok" = 1 || { cat "$repos_err" >&2; exit 1; }
